crombolo content check

Read-only: what installing a bundle's content here would do. Changes nothing.

crombolo content check <bundle> [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--exclude-people] [--save]
ArgumentWhat it is
bundleA package directory, or the name of a bundle this site depends on. Required.
--underPlace the bundle under this page.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--allow-missing-blobsImport media items whose files the bundle does not carry.
--publishPublish what it imports.
--no-schemaDecline the schema the bundle carries.
--no-filesDecline the views, styles and scripts it carries.
--replace-filesAllow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert.
--exclude-peopleLeave out the members and users it carries; this site's own are untouched.
--saveWrite the answers into the bundle.

crombolo content copy

Copy a page under another page; --descendants for the branch below it. Each run acts again.

crombolo content copy <page> --to <to> [--descendants] [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageThe page: a path or a uuid. Required.
--toThe page to copy it under; / for the top level. Required.
--descendantsThe pages below it too.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo content delete

Move pages, and the pages below them, to the recycle bin. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo content delete <page> [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageThe page: a path or a uuid; name more after it. Required.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo content export

Write a subtree as a private bundle package, to move to another environment. Each run acts again.

crombolo content export [--root <root>] --out <out> [--only] [--drafts] [--with-blueprints] [--with-blobs] [--with-members] [--with-users] [--name <name>] [--package-version <package-version>] [--include-content] [--allow-content-unencrypted]
ArgumentWhat it is
--rootThe subtree to export; repeatable.
--outThe directory to write the package to. Required.
--onlyThe roots alone, not what is below them.
--draftsDrafts, not only what is published.
--with-blueprintsThe blueprints of its types.
--with-blobsWith --include-content: the media files.
--with-membersMembers, encrypted.
--with-usersBack-office users, encrypted.
--nameThe package's npm name.
--package-versionThe package's version.
--include-contentBring property values and media files, encrypted under a passphrase.
--allow-content-unencryptedWith --include-content: write them readable.

crombolo content find

Find pages by their type, place, dates, state, name, text and values. Changes nothing.

crombolo content find [--type <type>] [--name <name>] [--name-match <name-match>] [--text <text>] [--under <under>] [--parent <parent>] [--max-depth <max-depth>] [--created-from <created-from>] [--created-to <created-to>] [--updated-from <updated-from>] [--updated-to <updated-to>] [--state <state>] [--culture <culture>] [--where <where>] [--sort <sort>] [--desc] [--skip <skip>] [--take <take>] [--remote <remote>] [--env <env>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--typeA content type, by alias or key.
--nameThe page name to match.
--name-matchHow --name matches. One of contains, startsWith, equals. Default contains.
--textWords in the page, through the search index.
--underOnly pages below this one.
--parentOnly the children of this page.
--max-depthHow many levels below --under or --parent.
--created-fromCreated on or after.
--created-toCreated on or before.
--updated-fromLast saved on or after.
--updated-toLast saved on or before.
--statePublished, draft, changed (published with unpublished changes) or trashed. One of published, draft, changed, trashed.
--cultureNames, states and values in this language.
--whereA value test: "<alias> <op> [value]", up to five.
--sortWhat to order by. One of name, createDate, updateDate, path, sortOrder. Default name.
--descNewest, last or Z first.
--skipHow many to skip. Default 0.
--takeHow many to return. Default 25.
--remoteSearch a hosted site through this remote, signed in as you.
--envThe remote's environment.

crombolo content import

Re-check, back up, then apply a bundle's content. Each run acts again.

crombolo content import <bundle> [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--exclude-people] [--label <label>] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
bundleA package directory, or the name of a bundle this site depends on. Required.
--underPlace the bundle under this page.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--allow-missing-blobsImport media items whose files the bundle does not carry.
--publishPublish what it imports.
--no-schemaDecline the schema the bundle carries.
--no-filesDecline the views, styles and scripts it carries.
--replace-filesAllow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert.
--exclude-peopleLeave out the members and users it carries; this site's own are untouched.
--labelA label for the run.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo content move

Move pages, and the pages below them, under another page. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo content move <page> --to <to> [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageThe page: a path or a uuid; name more after it. Required.
--toThe page to move them under; / for the top level. Required.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo content publish

Take a page live; --descendants for the branch below it. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo content publish <page> [--descendants] [--culture <culture>] [--at <at>] [--until <until>] [--skip-approval]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageThe page: a path or a uuid. Required.
--descendantsThe branch below it too.
--cultureOnly this culture; repeatable.
--atSchedule it for this time instead.
--untilSchedule the opposite for this time.
--skip-approvalGo ahead without the approval a page needs; the audit log records it.

crombolo content revert

Put an import back, restoring what the site served. Each run acts again.

crombolo content revert <run> [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--force] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
runThe run id: `crombolo content runs` lists them. Required.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=discard|skip.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of discard, skip.
--forceRevert over changes made since the run.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo content runs

The imports applied here, newest first. Changes nothing.

crombolo content runs [--limit <limit>] [--offset <offset>] [--fields <fields>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--limitHow many to list. Default 20.
--offsetHow many to skip first. Default 0.
--fieldsOnly these fields of each item, comma-separated.

crombolo content sort

Put the pages under a page in order. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo content sort <parent> <child> [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
parentThe page whose children to sort; / for the top level. Required.
childA page under it, by name, path or uuid; name more after it. Required.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo content unpublish

Take a page down; --descendants for the branch below it. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo content unpublish <page> [--descendants] [--culture <culture>] [--at <at>] [--until <until>] [--skip-approval]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageThe page: a path or a uuid. Required.
--descendantsThe branch below it too.
--cultureOnly this culture; repeatable.
--atSchedule it for this time instead.
--untilSchedule the opposite for this time.
--skip-approvalGo ahead without the approval a page needs; the audit log records it.

crombolo media delete

Move media items, and what is inside them, to the recycle bin. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo media delete <item> [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
itemThe media item: a path or a uuid; name more after it. Required.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo media export

Write media files back out as a folder tree. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo media export [<folder>] --out <out>
ArgumentWhat it is
folderA media folder, as a path or uuid; everything when not given.
--outThe folder to write into. Required.

crombolo media fetch

A lazily pulled site's media files, all of them now. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo media fetch

crombolo media import

Import a folder of files into the media library, keeping its folders. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo media import <dir> [--under <under>] [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
dirThe folder to import. Required.
--underThe media folder to import into; the root when not given.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo media move

Move media items, and what is inside them, into another folder. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo media move <item> --to <to> [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
itemThe media item: a path or a uuid; name more after it. Required.
--toThe folder to move them into; / for the top level. Required.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

crombolo seed apply

Apply seed/ to this site, through the same import as a bundle. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo seed apply [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--publish] [--dry-run] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--publishPublish what it applies.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo seed build

A bundle from a site directory: its schema, views, styles and seed. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo seed build [<dir>] [--template <template>] --out <out> [--name <name>] [--code <code>]
ArgumentWhat it is
dirThe site directory; this one when left out.
--templateA starter site the CLI ships, instead of a directory.
--outThe directory to write it to. Required.
--nameThe bundle's package name.
--codeThe site's own code, as globs; in place of crombolo.code in its package.json.

crombolo seed check

Read-only: check seed/ against this site's schema. Changes nothing.

crombolo seed check

crombolo seed export

Write seed files from content already in this site. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo seed export [<page>] [--all]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageA page: a path or a uuid; name more after it.
--allEvery page, Library element and media item, with its file.

crombolo dictionary export

The dictionary as Umbraco's .udt, to seed another environment. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo dictionary export --out <out> [--key <key>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--outThe file to write. Required.
--keyOnly this item and its children.

crombolo dictionary import

Apply a .udt file: items upsert by key. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo dictionary import <file>
ArgumentWhat it is
fileThe .udt file. Required.

crombolo domains apply

Apply domains.toml here, as a boot does. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo domains apply

crombolo domains clear

Unbind a page, in the file and in the database. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo domains clear <page>
ArgumentWhat it is
pageA path, a uuid, or / for the root page. Required.

crombolo domains list

The hostnames domains.toml declares, and what is bound here. Changes nothing.

crombolo domains list

crombolo domains set

Write a page's hostnames to domains.toml and apply it. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo domains set <page> [--host <host>] [--default-culture <default-culture>]
ArgumentWhat it is
pageA path, a uuid, or / for the root page. Required.
--hostA hostname, with its culture after =; repeatable.
--default-cultureThe page's fallback culture.

crombolo domains undo

Put back the file the last write replaced, and apply it. Each run acts again.

crombolo domains undo

crombolo recycle-bin empty

Delete what is in the recycle bin, for good. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo recycle-bin empty [--content] [--media] [--older-than <older-than>] [--yes] [--dry-run]
ArgumentWhat it is
--contentOnly pages.
--mediaOnly media, with their files.
--older-thanOnly what was trashed more than this many days ago.
--yesDon't ask.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.

values.value: the command line’s own description of its commands
Pages, media, seed files, the dictionary, domains and the recycle bin.
